newsitem.title: USA: Panama $500 million bond launching expected Monday.
newsitem.headline: Panama $500 million bond launching expected Monday.

text.p: Panama, which completed the final leg of its roadshow today in New York, is expected to launch its $500 million five-year global bond issue through lead manager BankBoston Corp on Monday, emerging market debt sources said.
Market sources, who attended the roadshow, said investor sentiment appeared to be extremely positive.

"There was definately a good turnout. It was more than I think people expected and sentiment was pretty positive so it should go well," said one fund manager at a major U.S. portfolio manamagement firm, who requested anonymity.
Price talk on the 144A deal is 175 to 205 basis points over comparable U.S. Treasury securities.
"I think it's pretty attractive," said another source, referring to the current price talk.
Emerging market sources said the favorable rating assigned to Panama two weeks ago by Moody's Investors Service Inc added to the positive tone.
On January 22, Moody's assigned a Ba1 rating to Panama's government bonds and a Baa1 to the country's soveriegn ceiling rating.
